instruction: Right now you are standing in a room move forward. On you are right side you can see a washing machine in front you can see a open door just exit the room from the open door and make a slight left turn where you can see a arch. Just enter into a arch and move forward and make a slight right. On you are right side you can see a sofa and move forward, on your left side you can see a poles. Turn to you are left and move forward. Right now you are in a kitchen area move forward on you are left side you can see a stove keep moving forward up to where you can see a open entrance in front of you beside the fridge. Just enter into that entrance and move closer near to the wall where you can see in front of you. Here we reached our destination.
